$comment: Quests. goal.type: move (value = meters) | jump | menu (target = phone app) | enter (building id) | travel (location) | activity (target = activity id or '*', count, value = min stars) | event (target = event type, value = optional min amount) | talk (target = location) | netWorth (value) | stat (target = stat key, value). Narwhal says `say` lines when a step starts (entrySay in Entry mode). marker points Narwhal and the beacon at a spot.

steps.text: Walk around the plaza (WASD or arrow keys)
steps.entryText: Walk around! Use W A S D or the arrow keys
say: Hi there! I'm NextGen Narwhal, your money guide. Welcome to Fin City!
Let's stretch those legs. Walk with W A S D or the arrow keys. Drag with your mouse to look around, or just click the ground to walk there.
entrySay: Hi! I'm NextGen Narwhal! Welcome to Fin City!
Let's walk! Use W A S D or the arrow keys. You can also click the ground to walk there.

steps.text: Jump with Space (hold Shift to sprint)
say: Nice moves! Now press Space to jump. Hold Shift to sprint.
entrySay: Great job! Press Space to jump. Hold Shift to run fast!

steps.text: Open your FinPhone (P key or the 📱 button)
steps.entryText: Open your FinPhone! Tap the 📱 button
say: See the top of your screen? That's your cash 💵 and your net worth 📈. Net worth is everything you own minus everything you owe.
Your FinPhone holds your bank, goals, net worth and more. Press P or click the 📱 button.
entrySay: Look at the top of the screen! That's your money 💵.
Now open your FinPhone! Press P or tap the 📱 button.

steps.text: Go into the Welcome Center
say: Follow me to the Welcome Center, just look for the golden beam of light! Press E at the door to go in.
entrySay: Follow me to the Welcome Center! Walk to the gold light and press E.

steps.text: Take the First Quiz at the counter
steps.proText: Take the Placement Test at the Orientation desk
say: Walk up to the First Quiz counter and press E. Don't worry about mistakes, I'll explain every answer!
proSay: Walk up to the Orientation desk and press E. The placement test adapts to you and shows where to start.
entrySay: Walk to the First Quiz and press E. It's okay to make mistakes. I'll help!

steps.text: Visit Fin City Bank
say: You earned some cash! Carrying cash is risky, it can get lost. Let's put it somewhere safe: Fin City Bank.
entrySay: You earned money! Let's keep it safe at the bank.

steps.text: Open a checking account at the Teller
say: A checking account is for everyday money: paychecks go in, purchases come out. Talk to the Teller to open one.
entrySay: A checking account is like a safe wallet at the bank. Talk to the Teller!

steps.text: Deposit cash into checking (Teller or ATM)
say: Now deposit your cash. Depositing means putting money into your account.
entrySay: Now put your cash in the bank. That's called a deposit!

steps.text: Open a savings account
say: Savings accounts pay you interest, the bank pays YOU for keeping money there. Open one at the Teller.
entrySay: A savings account helps your money grow! The bank pays you a little extra. Open one!

steps.text: Do an odd job from the board by the fountain
say: Most people earn money by working. The Odd Jobs board by the fountain has quick jobs, let's earn your first paycheck!
entrySay: People earn money by working! Let's do a job from the board by the fountain.

steps.text: Take the portal to San Francisco (west grove)
say: I've opened your first portal! San Francisco is the city of jobs and technology. The portals are in the grove on the west side of the park.
entrySay: I opened a magic portal! It goes to San Francisco. Follow me!

steps.text: Work a shift at the SF Job Center
say: Welcome to San Francisco! At the Job Center you can pick a real job. The better you do, the more you earn, and you can get promoted!
entrySay: This is San Francisco! Let's find a job at the Job Center.

steps.text: Travel to New York
say: New York's portal is open! New York is where people invest, buying small pieces of companies called shares.
entrySay: New York is open! There you can buy a tiny piece of a company. That's called a stock!

steps.text: Buy your first investment at the Brokerage
say: Head to the Brokerage and buy something. Tip: an index fund like FCX owns a little of every company, instant diversification!
entrySay: Go to the Brokerage and buy one share. FCX is a basket with a tiny piece of every company!

steps.text: Set a savings goal (FinPhone → Goals)
say: Saving is easier when you're saving FOR something. Open FinPhone → Goals and pick a goal, like a bike or a pet.
entrySay: What do you want to save for? A bike? A pet? Open your FinPhone and tap Goals!

steps.text: Add money to your goal
say: Now add some money to it. It moves into savings, where it earns interest while you wait.
entrySay: Now put some money in your goal. It will grow in savings!

steps.text: Buy something you like (Style Studio, Pet Shop, Furniture or Auto Dealer)
steps.proText: Buy something you like (Style Studio, Veterinary Clinic, Furniture or Auto Dealer)
say: Money is for living too! Treat yourself to something, but first ask: is it a need or a want? Wants are okay when you plan for them.
entrySay: Let's buy something fun! Is it a NEED or a WANT? Wants are okay if you plan for them.

steps.text: Open FinPhone → Net Worth
say: Let's check your net worth. It adds up everything you own, cash, bank, investments, stuff, and subtracts what you owe.
entrySay: Let's see your net worth! It's all your stuff and money, minus what you owe.

steps.text: Travel to London
say: London is open! It's the city of budgets and smart shopping.
entrySay: London is open! It's where we learn to plan our money.

steps.text: Make a budget at the Budget Planner
say: A budget is a plan for your money before you spend it. Try the Budget Planner!
entrySay: A budget is a money plan! Try the Budget Planner.

steps.text: Travel to Hong Kong
say: Hong Kong is open, the city of business and trade!
entrySay: Hong Kong is open! Let's run a business!

steps.text: Run the Night Market Stall
steps.proText: Hedge a position in the Harbour Futures Exchange
say: Run your own stall at the Night Market. Profit is what's left after you pay for supplies!
proSay: Head to the Futures Pit. Hedgers use futures to lock in prices; size the hedge to the exposure and keep cash ready for margin calls.
entrySay: Run your own snack stall! Profit is the money left after you pay for supplies.

steps.text: Travel to Singapore
say: Last portal! Singapore is about saving, protection and thinking long-term.
entrySay: The last portal! Singapore is all about saving for later.

steps.text: Grow a money tree in the Savings Garden
steps.proText: Set the mandate at the Sovereign Wealth Fund
say: Plant money in the Savings Garden and watch compound interest make it grow!
proSay: The Sovereign Wealth Fund invests a nation's savings for decades. Compounding, diversification and a sustainable payout all matter.
entrySay: Plant money in the Savings Garden and watch it grow!

steps.text: Visit 15 different buildings
say: You've seen all five cities! Now explore, every building has games and challenges. Daily challenges are in your FinPhone too.

steps.text: Have $500 in savings
say: Surprise bills happen. An emergency fund in savings keeps a surprise from becoming a problem. Let's build one!

steps.text: Own 3 different investments
say: Diversify! Owning several different investments lowers your risk.

steps.text: Reach a net worth of $10,000
say: Big goal time: grow your net worth to $10,000. Earn, save, invest, and be patient!

steps.text: Own a piece of land or a home
say: Land and homes can grow in value and earn rent. Visit the Real Estate Office when you're ready.

steps.text: Own a business (Hong Kong Business Registry)
say: Businesses can earn money while you do other things, passive income! Start one at the Hong Kong Business Registry.

steps.text: Reach a net worth of $100,000
say: You're doing amazing. Next stop: a $100,000 net worth!

steps.text: Reach a net worth of $1,000,000
say: The ultimate goal: one million dollars of net worth. Patience and compound growth will get you there!
